jobs.title: Payments Strategy & Business Development

titleByLocale.it: Strategie di Pagamento e Sviluppo Commerciale

jobs.description:
Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.
 In the Payments Strategy & Business Development role you will lead the commercial growth of AMINA Bank's global payments business by acquiring and managing strategic relationships across the payments ecosystem. Leveraging AMINA's regulated banking infrastructure and stablecoin-enabled payment rails, the role will help Payment Service Providers (PSPs), fintechs, financial institutions and corporates solve cross-border payment, treasury and settlement challenges. This is a strategic growth and business development role for an individual with an established network within the payments industry, a proven ability to originate and close enterprise relationships, and the commercial mindset to build a high-growth payments franchise within a regulated Swiss bank

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for AMINA's payments business, with a focus on cross-border payments, correspondent banking and stablecoin-enabled payment solutions.

• Build, manage and expand relationships with Payment Service Providers (PSPs), Payment Institutions, fintechs, payment processors, merchant acquirers, digital asset businesses, embedded finance providers and other participants within the global payments ecosystem.

• Identify, originate and close new business opportunities with institutional clients requiring international payment, treasury and settlement solutions.

• Own the end-to-end sales lifecycle, including pipeline generation, client engagement, solution design, commercial negotiations and contract execution.

• Work closely with prospective clients to understand their payment flows, operational challenges and liquidity requirements, developing tailored fiat and stablecoin-based payment solutions.

• Collaborate with Product, Operations, Compliance, Legal and Technology teams to successfully onboard clients and deliver scalable payment capabilities.

• Build strategic partnerships with correspondent banks, payment infrastructure providers, settlement partners and financial institutions to strengthen AMINA's payments offering.

• Own commercial growth targets, revenue generation and business development KPIs for the payments business. Maintain accurate CRM reporting and forecasting to track commercial performance against targets.

• Represent AMINA at industry conferences, fintech events and client meetings to expand the bank's presence within the global payments ecosystem.

• Monitor industry trends, competitor offerings and regulatory developments to identify new market opportunities and maintain AMINA's competitive positioning

• 8–15+ years of experience in strategic growth, enterprise sales, business development or relationship management within payments, banking, fintech or financial infrastructure.

• Proven success in originating, developing and closing strategic payment partnerships and institutional client relationships.

• Established network across Payment Service Providers (PSPs), Payment Institutions, fintechs, payment processors, merchant acquirers, digital asset companies or embedded finance providers.

• Strong understanding of global payment infrastructure, including correspondent banking, cross-border payments, SWIFT and other international payment networks.

• Good understanding of stable coins, digital assets and blockchain-based payment infrastructure. Experience commercializing stablecoin payment solutions is highly desirable.

• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify market opportunities, structure client solutions and build sustainable revenue streams.

• Demonstrated experience launching new markets, products or commercial initiatives within payments, fintech or financial services.

• Excellent executive relationship management, negotiation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.

• Experience working with international clients across Europe, the UK, Middle East or North America is preferred.

• Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, capable of building a new business line within a fast-growing, regulated financial institution.
 We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su AMINA Bank

Fondata ad aprile 2018 e con sede a Zug, AMINA Bank è un pioniere nel settore finanziario. Ad agosto 2019, AMINA ha ricevuto una licenza bancaria e di intermediario in valori mobiliari svizzera da FINMA. Lo spettro ampio e verticalmente integrato di servizi, combinato con i più alti standard di sicurezza, rende la proposta di valore di AMINA unica.

AMINA opera globalmente dai suoi hub regolamentati in Svizzera, Abu Dhabi e Hong Kong per offrire servizi in valuta fiat e cripto agli investitori progressisti, sia tradizionali che nativi della cripto, siano persone fisiche, società o istituzioni.

Il CVVC Global Report e CB Insights hanno nominato AMINA come una delle Top 50 Companies dell'ecosistema blockchain. Aite Group ha assegnato ad AMINA il Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award 2021 nella categoria "Digital Startup of the Year", e LinkedIn ha elencato AMINA come una delle Top Startups 2021 in Svizzera. Nel 2022, AMINA ha vinto il Digital Assets Offering or Service presso i WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, e la banca è stata anche riconosciuta per la sua offerta di prodotti SEBAX e ha vinto il Best ETP of the Year award presso i Swiss ETF Awards 2022. Nel 2023, AMINA ha vinto l'European WealthBriefing Award nella categoria Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager.

Descrizione

Nel ruolo di Payments Strategy & Business Development guiderai la crescita commerciale dell'attività di pagamenti globale di AMINA Bank acquisendo e gestendo relazioni strategiche nell'ecosistema dei pagamenti. Sfruttando l'infrastruttura bancaria regolamentata di AMINA e le rail di pagamento abilitate da stablecoin, il ruolo aiuterà i Payment Service Providers (PSP), le fintech, le istituzioni finanziarie e le aziende a risolvere sfide di pagamento transfrontaliero, tesoreria e regolamento. Questo è un ruolo di crescita strategica e sviluppo commerciale per un individuo con una rete consolidata nell'industria dei pagamenti, una comprovata capacità di originare e chiudere relazioni aziendali, e la mentalità commerciale per costruire un'attività di pagamenti ad alta crescita all'interno di una banca svizzera regolamentata.

Responsabilità

- Sviluppare ed eseguire la strategia commerciale per l'attività di pagamenti di AMINA, con focus su pagamenti transfrontalieri, banche corrispondenti e soluzioni di pagamento abilitate da stablecoin.

- Costruire, gestire ed espandere relazioni con Payment Service Providers (PSP), Istituzioni di Pagamento, fintech, processori di pagamento, merchant acquirer, attività di asset digitali, fornitori di finanza incorporata e altri partecipanti dell'ecosistema dei pagamenti globale.

- Identificare, originare e chiudere nuove opportunità commerciali con clienti istituzionali che necessitano soluzioni internazionali di pagamento, tesoreria e regolamento.

- Possedere l'intero ciclo di vendita end-to-end, inclusi generazione di pipeline, coinvolgimento dei clienti, progettazione di soluzioni, negoziazioni commerciali ed esecuzione di contratti.

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti potenziali per comprendere i loro flussi di pagamento, sfide operative e requisiti di liquidità, sviluppando soluzioni di pagamento su base fiat e stablecoin personalizzate.

- Collaborare con i team di Prodotto, Operazioni, Conformità, Legale e Tecnologia per onboardare con successo i clienti e fornire capacità di pagamento scalabili.

- Costruire partnership strategiche con banche corrispondenti, fornitori di infrastruttura di pagamento, partner di regolamento e istituzioni finanziarie per rafforzare l'offerta di pagamenti di AMINA.

- Possedere target di crescita commerciale, generazione di entrate e KPI di sviluppo commerciale per l'attività di pagamenti. Mantenere report CRM e forecasting accurati per tracciare le performance commerciali rispetto ai target.

- Rappresentare AMINA alle conferenze di settore, eventi fintech e riunioni con clienti per espandere la presenza della banca all'interno dell'ecosistema dei pagamenti globale.

- Monitorare le tendenze di settore, le offerte dei competitor e gli sviluppi normativi per identificare nuove opportunità di mercato e mantenere il posizionamento competitivo di AMINA.

What we offer

Dobbiamo la nostra crescita esponenziale al nostro spirito di team innovativo e collaborativo e alla nostra forza lavoro di talento. Ogni voce conta perché siamo sempre impegnati a imparare da prospettive e background diversi perché le nostre persone fanno la differenza in AMINA Bank. Indipendentemente dalla tua età, genere, credo e background, ad AMINA TUTTI sono benvenuti!

Unisciti al nostro team esperto e insieme ridefinisci la finanza.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über AMINA Bank

AMINA Bank wurde im April 2018 gegründet und hat ihren Sitz in Zug. Sie ist ein Pionier in der Finanzbranche. Im August 2019 erhielt AMINA eine Swiss Banking und Securities Dealer Lizenz von der FINMA. Das breite, vertikal integrierte Spektrum von Dienstleistungen, kombiniert mit höchsten Sicherheitsstandards, macht AMINAs Wertangebot einzigartig.

AMINA operiert global von seinen regulierten Hubs in der Schweiz, Abu Dhabi und Hongkong, um Finanz- und Kryptodienstleistungen für progressive Investoren anzubieten, sowohl traditionelle als auch Krypto-native, sei es Einzelpersonen, Unternehmen oder Institutionen.

Der CVVC Global Report und CB Insights haben AMINA als eines der Top 50 Unternehmen des Blockchain-Ökosystems benannt. Aite Group verlieh AMINA 2021 den Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in der Kategorie "Digital Startup of the Year", und LinkedIn listete AMINA als eines der Top Startups 2021 in der Schweiz auf. 2022 gewann AMINA den Digital Assets Offering or Service bei den WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, und die Bank wurde auch für ihr Produktangebot SEBAX anerkannt und gewann den Best ETP of the Year Award bei den Swiss ETF Awards 2022. 2023 gewann AMINA den European WealthBriefing Award in der Kategorie Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager.

Beschreibung

In der Rolle "Zahlungsstrategien & Geschäftsentwicklung" wirst du das kommerzielle Wachstum des globalen Zahlungsgeschäfts von AMINA Bank vorantreiben, indem du strategische Beziehungen im Zahlungsökosystem akquirierst und verwaltest. Durch die Nutzung der regulierten Bankinfrastruktur von AMINA und stabilitätscoingestützter Zahlungsschienen wird die Rolle Payment Service Providern (PSP), Fintechs, Finanzinstitutionen und Unternehmen helfen, grenzüberschreitende Zahlungen, Finanzverwaltungs- und Abrechnungsprobleme zu lösen. Dies ist eine strategische Wachstums- und Geschäftsentwicklungsrolle für eine Person mit einem etablierten Netzwerk in der Zahlungsbranche, bewiesener Fähigkeit, Enterprise-Beziehungen zu originieren und abzuschließen, und der kommerziellen Mentalität, um ein stark wachsendes Zahlungsgeschäft innerhalb einer regulierten Schweizer Bank aufzubauen.

Aufgaben

- Entwicklung und Ausführung der Geschäftsstrategie für das Zahlungsgeschäft von AMINA mit Fokus auf grenzüberschreitende Zahlungen, Korrespondenzbanking und stabilitätscoingestützte Zahlungslösungen.

- Aufbau, Verwaltung und Erweiterung von Beziehungen mit Payment Service Providern (PSP), Zahlungsinstitutionen, Fintechs, Zahlungsabwicklern, Merchant Acquirern, Digitalanlagengeschäften, Eingebettete-Finanz-Anbietern und anderen Teilnehmern im globalen Zahlungsökosystem.

- Identifizierung, Originierung und Abschluss neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mit institutionellen Kunden, die internationale Zahlungs-, Finanzverwaltungs- und Abrechnungslösungen benötigen.

- Verantwortung für den gesamten End-to-End-Verkaufszyklus, einschließlich Pipeline-Generierung, Kundenengagement, Lösungsdesign, kommerzielle Verhandlungen und Vertragsabschluss.

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit potenziellen Kunden, um ihre Zahlungsströme, betriebliche Herausforderungen und Liquiditätsanforderungen zu verstehen, und Entwicklung von maßgeschneiderten Fiat- und Stabilitätscoin-basierten Zahlungslösungen.

- Zusammenarbeit mit Produkt-, Betriebs-, Compliance-, Rechts- und Technologie-Teams, um Kunden erfolgreich zu onboarden und skalierbare Zahlungsfunktionen bereitzustellen.

- Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften mit Korrespondenzbanken, Zahlungsinfrastruktur-Anbietern, Abrechnungspartnern und Finanzinstitutionen, um das Zahlungsangebot von AMINA zu stärken.

- Verantwortung für kommerzielle Wachstumsziele, Umsatzgenerierung und KPI der Geschäftsentwicklung für das Zahlungsgeschäft. Führung genauer CRM-Berichte und Prognosen zur Verfolgung der kommerziellen Leistung gegenüber Zielen.

- Vertretung von AMINA bei Branchenkonferenzen, Fintech-Events und Kundentreffen, um die Präsenz der Bank im globalen Zahlungsökosystem zu erweitern.

- Überwachung von Branchentrends, Wettbewerber-Angeboten und regulatorischen Entwicklungen, um neue Marktchancen zu identifizieren und AMINAs Wettbewerbsposition zu wahren.

What we offer

Wir verdanken unser exponentielles Wachstum unserem innovativen und kollaborativen Teamgeist und unserem talentierten Workforce. Jede Stimme zählt, da wir uns immer verpflichtet haben, von vielfältigen Perspektiven und Hintergründen zu lernen, denn unsere Menschen machen den Unterschied bei AMINA Bank. Unabhängig von deinem Alter, Geschlecht, Glaube und Hintergrund sind bei AMINA ALLE willkommen!

Tritt unserem erfahrenen Team bei und gestalte gemeinsam Finanzen neu.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À propos d'AMINA Bank

Fondée en avril 2018 et basée à Zug, AMINA Bank est un pionnier du secteur financier. En août 2019, AMINA a reçu une licence bancaire et de courtier en valeurs mobilières suisse de la FINMA. Le large spectre de services intégrés verticalement, combiné aux normes de sécurité les plus élevées, rend la proposition de valeur d'AMINA unique.

AMINA opère mondialement à partir de ses centres régulés en Suisse, à Abu Dhabi et à Hong Kong pour offrir des services en monnaie fiduciaire et crypto aux investisseurs progressistes, tant traditionnels que natifs de la cryptographie, qu'il s'agisse de particuliers, de sociétés ou d'institutions.

Le Rapport CVVC Global et CB Insights ont nommé AMINA comme l'une des Top 50 Companies de l'écosystème blockchain. Aite Group a décerné à AMINA le Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award 2021 dans la catégorie « Digital Startup of the Year », et LinkedIn a classé AMINA parmi les Top Startups 2021 en Suisse. En 2022, AMINA a remporté le Digital Assets Offering or Service aux WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, et la banque a également été reconnue pour son offre de produits SEBAX et a remporté le Best ETP of the Year award aux Swiss ETF Awards 2022. En 2023, AMINA a remporté le European WealthBriefing Award dans la catégorie Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager.

Description

Dans le rôle de Stratégie de Paiements et Développement Commercial, tu dirigeras la croissance commerciale de l'activité de paiements mondiale d'AMINA Bank en acquérant et en gérant des relations stratégiques dans l'écosystème des paiements. En tirant parti de l'infrastructure bancaire réglementée d'AMINA et des rails de paiement activés par stablecoin, le rôle aidera les prestataires de services de paiement (PSP), les fintech, les institutions financières et les sociétés à résoudre les défis des paiements transfrontaliers, de la gestion de la trésorerie et du règlement. Ceci est un rôle de croissance stratégique et de développement commercial pour une personne disposant d'un réseau établi au sein de l'industrie des paiements, d'une capacité avérée à générer et conclure des relations avec les entreprises, et de l'état d'esprit commercial pour construire une franchise de paiements à forte croissance au sein d'une banque suisse réglementée.

Responsabilités

- Développer et exécuter la stratégie commerciale de l'activité de paiements d'AMINA, avec un accent sur les paiements transfrontaliers, les banques correspondantes et les solutions de paiement activées par stablecoin.

- Construire, gérer et étendre les relations avec les prestataires de services de paiement (PSP), les institutions de paiement, les fintech, les processeurs de paiement, les acquéreurs marchands, les entreprises d'actifs numériques, les fournisseurs de financement intégré et les autres participants de l'écosystème mondial des paiements.

- Identifier, générer et conclure les nouvelles opportunités commerciales avec les clients institutionnels nécessitant des solutions internationales de paiement, de gestion de trésorerie et de règlement.

- Être responsable du cycle de vente end-to-end complet, y compris la génération de pipeline, l'engagement des clients, la conception de solutions, les négociations commerciales et l'exécution des contrats.

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les clients potentiels pour comprendre leurs flux de paiement, leurs défis opérationnels et leurs besoins en liquidités, en développant des solutions de paiement personnalisées basées sur la monnaie fiduciaire et les stablecoin.

- Collaborer avec les équipes Produit, Opérations, Conformité, Juridique et Technologie pour intégrer avec succès les clients et fournir des capacités de paiement évolutives.

- Construire des partenariats stratégiques avec les banques correspondantes, les fournisseurs d'infrastructure de paiement, les partenaires de règlement et les institutions financières pour renforcer l'offre de paiements d'AMINA.

- Être responsable des objectifs de croissance commerciale, de la génération de revenus et des KPI de développement commercial pour l'activité de paiements. Maintenir des rapports CRM précis et des prévisions pour suivre les performances commerciales par rapport aux objectifs.

- Représenter AMINA aux conférences du secteur, aux événements fintech et aux réunions clients pour étendre la présence de la banque dans l'écosystème mondial des paiements.

- Surveiller les tendances du secteur, les offres des concurrents et les évolutions réglementaires pour identifier les nouvelles opportunités de marché et maintenir le positionnement concurrentiel d'AMINA.

What we offer

Nous devons notre croissance exponentielle à notre esprit d'équipe innovant et collaboratif et à notre main-d'œuvre talentueuse. Chaque voix compte car nous nous engageons toujours à apprendre de perspectives et de milieux divers, car nos collaborateurs font la différence chez AMINA Bank. Quel que soit ton âge, ton sexe, tes croyances et ton origine, chez AMINA TOUT LE MONDE est bienvenu!

Rejoin notre équipe compétente et ensemble, redéfinissons la finance.

The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique. ​

Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.We are looking for a Executive Director B2B Sales to drive the Bank’s institutional growth by acquiring and developing high-value B2B relationships across private banks, pension funds, and other institutional as well as corporate clients. The role leads end-to-end sales processes including RFPs, onboarding coordination, and key-account management while ensuring exceptional service delivery and strategic alignment. You will collaborate cross-functionally to enhance client experience, optimize processes, and secure scalable partnerships that expand the Bank’s B2B footprint. Strategic Market Development

• Lead the bank’s institutional and B2B growth strategy across Private Banks, Pension Funds, Institutional Investors, and Corporate C lients.

• Drive expansion specifically within the DACH (Germany, Switzerland, Austria) region but also opportunistically in other EEA countries , leveraging established networks and market knowledge ,

• Secure large-scale institutional partnerships, including omnibus account structures, platform integrations, and product‑distribution agreements.

• Oversee end-to-end RFP processes, ensuring strong proposal quality, senior-level negotiations, and seamless onboarding.

Key Account Leadership

• Act as the senior executive representative for major high‑revenue institutional clients.

• Drive proactive account revenue growth by identifying and executing upselling and cross-selling opportunities, expanding client relationships, increasing product penetration, and maximizing long-term commercial value across institutional accounts.

• L ead long‑term relationship management, revenue optimization, and strategic account planning.

• Engage C‑suite stakeholders to drive adoption of digital asset solutions, custody, trading, tokenization, and related offerings.

Operational Oversight & Cross‑Functional Coordination

• Provide senior oversight on complex onboarding processes, including institutional KYC, AML, and documentation workflows.

• Represent B2B priorities internally and ensure alignment with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Product, Technology, and Legal teams.

• Strengthen operational processes to enable scalability, efficiency, and robust risk controls.

Client Experience & Digital Enablement

• Oversee the institutional client experience across digital banking platforms, communication channels, and digital onboarding.

• Collaborate with technology and product leadership to drive enhancements in digital asset infrastructure, wallet architecture, APIs, and platform experience.

• Champion technical improvements to ensure secure, efficient, and compliant digital asset operations.

Executive Governance & Strategic Project Leadership

• Lead cross‑functional strategic initiatives, including institutional integrations, digital asset product launches, and partnership expansions.

• Work directly with Executive Committee members and the Board on strategic priorities.

• Contribute to long‑term B2B and digital asset strategy, ensuring alignment with regulatory, market, and competitive developments.

• University degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field; CFA/CAIA is a plus.

• Strong hands-on experience in the digital assets industry (custody, trading, tokenization, blockchain infrastructure, crypto products).

• Proven experience in the DACH/Germany market with an established institutional network.

• Strong technical understanding of blockchain, custody, wallets, token standards, APIs, and digital asset risk frameworks.

• Experience profile:
 10–14 years in regulated banking with strong institutional/B2B exposure and digital asset expertise ; or
